verdict.rationale: Pomelo documents its own tokenization feature that enables cards in Apple Pay, Google Pay and other digital wallets [pomelo-docs-11], available for Visa and Mastercard credit, debit and prepaid cards [pomelo-docs-29]. That covers the core of cards landing in wallets, but the evidence consists of brief guide summaries, and none of the story's specific developer elements are evidenced. missing for 10: in-app push provisioning SDK/API, documented Apple/Google entitlements process, in-wallet card art configuration, manual provisioning fallback, independent or hands-on corroboration.
